sections.heading: Answer an open data query
sections.text: Data queries raised by monitors or data managers appear as a flag icon on the affected field. Site users answer a query by opening the flag, entering a response, and selecting Submit Response. Answering a query does not change the field value.

steps.text: Ask the user to open the form and select the flag icon next to the queried field.
Ask the user to enter a response in the query window and select Submit Response.

information_needed.prompt: The query identifier shown in the query window.

stop_conditions.text: If the user asks support to enter or change the data value on their behalf, stop; data values may only be changed by authorized site staff.

sections.heading: Answered query does not close
sections.text: A query closes only after the person who raised it reviews the response. A query showing Answered is waiting for that review and is not stuck.

steps.text: Share this article section explaining that answered queries close after the reviewer reviews the response.

information_needed.prompt: The query identifier shown in the query window.
